pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions when floating unrealized losses or when momentum oscillators show divergence on the 1m/5m charts.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block confirmation combined with volume delta exhaustion before any entry is authorized; zero trades during initial 15-minute session opens.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$6.00 profit and trail remaining position with a hard breakeven plus trailing stop to guarantee a $15-$30+ asymmetric payout.
